Sleeping giant: Airtel Payments Bank may list in 3 to 4 years, says Sunil Mittal

Sunil Bharti Mittal, Chairman of Bharti Enterprises, which owns Airtel, believes the payments bank has the potential to emerge as a much larger financial services business, describing it as a "sleeping giant" with nearly 100 million customers and revenue approaching ₹4,000 crore.
